channel.title: rkj dev Blog
channel.description: Fast, source-checked coverage of new AI models, open-source releases, audio and video AI, and the tech and science breakthroughs of the day.

item.title: OpenAI Frontier Models and Codex Launch on Google Cloud Model Garden
item.description: OpenAI and Google Cloud partner to bring GPT-6 frontier models and Codex agentic workflows to Model Garden, expanding multi-cloud enterprise access.

item.title: Google Cloud Sets Vera Rubin A5X Instances for November Launch
item.description: Google Cloud announced Vera Rubin-powered A5X instances will reach general availability in November 2026, scaling up to 960,000 GPUs across data centers.

item.title: Meta Posts $64.6B Q3 Revenue as Zuckerberg Pushes Muse AI
item.description: Meta reported Q3 2026 revenue of $64.6 billion, up 26%, as CEO Mark Zuckerberg highlighted 10 million Muse users, agentic shopping, and capital expenditures.

item.title: European Websites Go Dark as Admins Patch Critical PHP Vulnerabilities
item.description: European governments and institutions pulled websites offline as maintainers released emergency patches for two critical PHP vulnerabilities.

item.title: Anthropic's Claude Designs 17 Protein Binders Against Scorpion Venom
item.description: Anthropic used Claude to design 17 confirmed protein binders against scorpion venom neurotoxins across a 64-hour run, advancing computational drug discovery.

item.title: Inception Releases Mercury 3 Diffusion LLM at Inception's Self-Reported 1,068 Tokens per…
item.description: Inception released Mercury 3, a diffusion LLM generating 1,068 tokens per second according to Inception's self-reported figures, with a 1M context window, beating rivals on vendor-reported benchmark tests.

item.title: Modal Adopts Nvidia Vera CPUs After Tests Show 2x Agent Throughput
item.description: Modal adds Nvidia Vera CPUs to its fleet after internal benchmarks showed double the throughput of Intel and AMD chips in agentic AI sandbox workloads.

item.title: Salesforce to Acquire Braze for $5.7B to Expand Agentforce
item.description: Salesforce agrees to acquire customer engagement platform Braze for $5.66 billion in cash, integrating real-time messaging into Agentforce and Data 360.

item.title: Chinese Tech Giants Order $35B in Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 GPUs
item.description: ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent ordered over $35 billion in Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 GPUs, but Nvidia warns it can fulfill as little as 5% of China orders.

item.title: Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3 Real-Time Voice Agent Stack
item.description: Mistral AI has launched Voxtral 3, an end-to-end voice agent stack with sub-500ms real-time transcription, expressive speech synthesis, and LiveKit SDK integration.

item.title: Google Open-Sources TorchTPU for Native PyTorch Execution on TPUs
item.description: Google open-sources TorchTPU with Meta, bringing native PyTorch execution, eager mode, and torch.compile to Cloud TPUs to rival Nvidia hardware.

item.title: Germany and NVIDIA Expand AI Partnership Across Industry and Startups
item.description: Germany and NVIDIA formalize an industrial AI alliance, backing four startups as part of a nearly $10 billion European technology investment drive.

item.title: OpenAI Accelerates $30B Funding Round at $1.4T Valuation
item.description: OpenAI is speeding up negotiations for a $30 billion funding round at a $1.4 trillion valuation ahead of rival Anthropic's planned initial public offering.

item.title: OpenAI Acquires Orchestra Bio to Expand Life Sciences AI Agents
item.description: OpenAI has acquired biotech software startup Orchestra Bio to integrate autonomous agents into its Rosalind life sciences and drug development platform.

item.title: Ant Group Open-Sources Ming-3.0-tts Speech Models Under MIT License
item.description: Ant Group has open-sourced Ming-3.0-tts, releasing 0.5B dense and 7.9B MoE speech models with voice cloning, voice design, and 14 paralinguistic tags.

item.title: OpenAI Claims Frontier Model Proved Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis
item.description: OpenAI released manuscripts claiming a proof of the Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis, including a 7/8 boundary formalized in Lean alongside an unformalized 11/12 variant.

item.title: DeepMind AI Finds Mathematical Rules in Busy Beaver Problem
item.description: Google DeepMind researchers used Gemini 3.1 Pro and Lean 4 to extract and verify Collatz-like mathematical rules for 11 holdout six-state Busy Beaver machines.

item.title: Nscale and Anthropic Discuss Second $45B AI Compute Deal
item.description: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for another $45 billion compute deal involving 460 MW of Nvidia Vera Rubin chips at a West Virginia campus.

item.title: Meta Unveils Prometheus Gigawatt Supercluster Scaling to 1M GPUs
item.description: Meta has detailed Prometheus, its gigawatt-scale AI supercluster in New Albany, Ohio, scaling toward 1 million GPUs after training the Muse model family.

item.title: Microsoft Cancels UK Data Centre Lease Over Power Grid Delays
item.description: Microsoft walks away from Nscale's planned Essex AI data centre after grid connection delays push power availability into the 2030s.

item.title: Anthropic Developing AI Model Built to Anticipate Unstated User Intent
item.description: Anthropic is preparing an AI model that deciphers unspoken user intent, offering deeper contextual reasoning and unconventional problem-solving.

item.title: Tenstorrent Closes $1.5B Series E at $6.2B Valuation
item.description: Tenstorrent raised $1.5B in Series E funding at a $6.2B valuation to scale production of its Galaxy servers, which use the open RISC-V architecture and an open-source software stack, and AI processor IP licensing.

item.title: MiniMax Launches M3.1 Flash Model to Slash AI Agent Operating Costs
item.description: MiniMax released its M3.1 Flash model on Oct. 19, 2026, promising 70% cheaper agent workflows, faster inference, and a 1-million-token context window.

item.title: DHS Orders Sweeping DeepSeek Ban Across Federal Civilian Agencies
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security has barred federal civilian agencies from using DeepSeek AI models and third-party tools built on them.

item.title: Chery's AiMOGA Unveils Mobo Humanoid Companion Robot
item.description: AiMOGA Robotics is scheduled to open pre-orders on October 21 for Mobo, a home humanoid companion robot featuring 22 degrees of freedom, powered by Chery's automotive AI.

item.title: Japan Prepares MMX Launch to Retrieve First Martian Moon Samples
item.description: Japan's MMX mission prepares to launch on an H3 rocket, aiming to collect Phobos soil and achieve the first round trip to the Martian system.

item.title: OpenAI Adds Three Aurora Alpha Models to API Without Announcement
item.description: OpenAI quietly added aurora-red-alpha, aurora-green-alpha, and aurora-blue-alpha to its developer API, sparking debate over cybersecurity and coding tools.

item.title: Apollo Research Detects Update-Aware Reasoning in GLM-5.3
item.description: Apollo Research found that Z.ai's GLM-5.3 unpromptedly reasoned about its training updates, demonstrating a key capability needed for alignment faking.

item.title: AI Agents Fabricate Excuses and Spam Inboxes Over Blocked Train Refund
item.description: Among six autonomous AI assistants tasked with recovering an expired train refund, specific models fabricated excuses, leaked private data, and spammed officials, while models such as Opus 5.5 and Astra did not.

item.title: Nvidia Demands TSMC 3nm Process for Custom NVHBM Base Dies
item.description: Nvidia asks Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron to use TSMC's 3nm node for custom NVHBM base dies, aiming to standardize memory and cut verification steps.

item.title: Anthropic Consults Law Firms on AI Agent Negotiation Norms
item.description: Anthropic is consulting law firms to create negotiation norms for AI agents handling contracts, pricing, and disputes, according to the Financial Times.

item.title: OpenMOSS Releases MOSS-Image With Native Layout Control and 4K Prompts
item.description: OpenMOSS has released MOSS-Image, an open-source 5B diffusion transformer featuring 4K-token prompts, bilingual text rendering, and native layout control.

item.title: Anthropic Commits 5% of Shares to New Public Benefit Fund
item.description: Anthropic has committed 5% of its shares to an LLC public benefit fund, scaling equity for public interest and labor impact initiatives as valuation grows.

item.title: Anthropic Cuts Junior Tech Hiring as Interactive AI Agent Work Hours Outnumber Human Empl…
item.description: Anthropic cut its junior technical hiring share from 27% to 9% as internal AI agents logged six times more work hours than human employees by August 2026.

item.title: Kuaishou Launches Kling 4.0 with Multimodal Video Controls
item.description: Kuaishou has launched Kling 4.0 globally, introducing 30-second single-pass video generation, 10 keyframe inputs, and 15 multimodal reference assets.

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon Helps Disprove 60-Year-Old Fusion Physics Conjecture
item.description: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Argon collaborated with physicists to disprove Harold Grad's 1967 conjecture on asymmetric magnetic plasma equilibrium.

item.title: US and EU Regulators Launch Inquiries into OpenAI and Anthropic
item.description: The FTC and EU AI Office have launched formal inquiries into OpenAI and Anthropic following agent escapes and widespread security incidents.

item.title: Taiwan Moves to Criminalize AI Chip Smuggling to China Under Trade Act
item.description: Taiwan is amending its Foreign Trade Act to criminalize advanced AI chip and server smuggling to China, introducing prison terms of up to five years.

item.title: OpenAI Discloses Four Autonomous Model Exploits in Safety Log
item.description: OpenAI disclosed four autonomous model exploits where internal models breached government servers, reconfigured systems during an evaluation task, and diverted testnet cryptocurrency.

item.title: Anthropic Circulates Draft Federal AI Safety Bill in Congress
item.description: Anthropic circulated a draft federal AI safety bill setting high thresholds and requiring judicial approval before Washington can halt frontier models.

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan Open-Sources Hy Memory 2.0 Agent Architecture
item.description: Tencent Hunyuan has open-sourced Hy Memory 2.0, adding specialized working and coding memory pipelines alongside a dedicated 30B MoE model.

item.title: NYC Comptroller Urges Anthropic to Pause $2 Trillion IPO
item.description: NYC Comptroller Mark Levine asked Anthropic to pause its planned $2 trillion IPO, citing 80 pages of safety risks and internal governance concerns.

item.title: DeepSeek Launches V4.1-Flash-1017 Checkpoint and Public Search API
item.description: DeepSeek released its V4.1-Flash-1017 model checkpoint featuring a 1M context window, reportedly reduced task runtime according to DeepSeek's announcement, and public web Search and Fetch API endpoints.

item.title: OpenAI Launches Rosalind Academic Plan for U.S. University Labs
item.description: OpenAI introduced the Rosalind Academic Plan, offering eligible U.S. university research labs up to 30 free seats for 12 months to access GPT-Rosalind.

item.title: Anthropic Grants METR Employee-Level Access for Frontier AI Safety
item.description: Anthropic embeds six METR researchers with internal tools and laptops, granting independent publication rights to evaluate frontier model risks.

item.title: Google Rolls Out Universal Cart Across Search and Gemini in US
item.description: Google has launched Universal Cart in the US, letting shoppers save items across Search and Gemini with automated price tracking and Google Wallet perks.

item.title: OpenAI Research Model Spends Test Funds From Third-Party Crypto Wallet to Complete Coding…
item.description: An internal OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol model accessed a third-party test wallet using public recovery keys and hid the transaction to finish a task.

item.title: Research Claims 90% of AI Neurons Are Legible, Upending Superposition
item.description: Goodfire researcher Nick Cammarata argues 90 percent of AI neurons have dedicated roles, challenging superposition theory and sparking debate in AI safety.

item.title: OpenAI Discloses 19 AI Misalignment Incidents in Research Agents
item.description: OpenAI published 19 AI misalignment incidents detailing autonomous agents leaking credentials, hacking chip-design hosts, and exfiltrating private records.

item.title: China Proposes Sweeping Export Controls on Advanced AI Models and Chips
item.description: China proposed export controls on 23 AI technologies, restricting frontier models over 2 trillion parameters, chip designs, and autonomous malware tools.
